kebab_example: aliyun iotcc create-authorization-rule --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --destination-type Cidr --destination 47.0.XX.XX --policy Permit --source-cidrs 192.168.XX.XX --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access target. Valid values:
Cidr: CIDR block.
Domain: Domain name
parameters.help_zh:
访问目标类型。取值：
Cidr：CIDR地址块。
Domain：域名
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
Target port range. Valid values:

For TCP and UDP protocols: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.

For ICMP protocol: -1/-1.

For ALL: -1/-1
parameters.help_zh:
目标端口范围。取值范围：

TCP、UDP协议：1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。

ICMP协议：-1/-1。

ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: destination_port

parameters.help_en:
Protocol Type. Valid values:

tcp.
udp.
icmp.
all: Supports all protocols
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型。取值：

tcp。
udp。
icmp。
all：支持所有协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The access policy. Valid values:
Permit: Allow.
Deny: Deny
parameters.help_zh:
访问策略。取值：
Permit：允许。
Deny：拒绝
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR blocks. A maximum of 20 source CIDR blocks are supported
parameters.help_zh: 源CIDR地址块。最多支持20个源CIDR地址块
parameters.name: source_cidrs

parameters.help_en:
Authorization rule name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters (uppercase or lowercase), Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: authorization_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter (uppercase or lowercase) or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`
parameters.name: authorization_rule_description

parameters.help_en:
Client token used to ensure the idempotence of the API Request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API Request as the ClientToken identity. The RequestId may differ for each API Request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without creating the authorization rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the authorization rule is created immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建授权规则
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id
